mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure with easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.
